title: American Express pricing - 1.43%-3.30% merchant discount rate plus card annual fees
clean_text: American Express charges merchants a "Discount" rate typically ranging from 1.43% + $0.10 to 3.30% + $0.10 per transaction; with the OptBlue program (since 2014) widening acceptance, effective costs for most merchants are now much closer to other card networks, though large-volume merchants with direct Amex relationships may still face higher rates. Separately, for cardholders, business card programs charge $95 for up to 5 employee cards then $95 per additional card, while premium cards like Business Gold carry a $375 annual fee. Other merchant-side fees can include non-swiped transaction fees, voice authorization fees, and paper statement fees.

meta.pricing_model: annual card fee plus merchant discount rate
